repair.title: More Nature Is Protected
repair.summary: In 2024, protected and conserved areas covered 17.6 percent of land and inland waters and 8.4 percent of marine areas.
repair.why_it_matters: More ecosystems now have at least some formal protection instead of being left entirely exposed.
repair.caveat: Coverage is not the same as good management, and the world is still short of the 2030 target.
